# li-tools Suite

> Modern developer CLI toolchain featuring gpgkit, certkit, and tokenkit, powered by Java 25 & GraalVM Native Image.

li-tools is an AI-first, zero-runtime-dependency developer security suite designed around the philosophy of "Convention over Configuration" and "Triple-Platform Parity" (macOS, Linux, and Windows 11).

## AI Agent Skills (agentskills.io Standard)

All tools in this suite provide native, machine-readable `SKILL.md` documents for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot CLI, OpenCode):

- [Suite Skill (li-tools)](https://tools.lihu.me/SKILL.md): Suite overview, task matrix, and installation guidelines.
- [gpgkit Skill](https://tools.lihu.me/gpgkit/SKILL.md): Comprehensive agent reference for GPG key generation, commit signing, and encrypted backup.
- [certkit Skill](https://tools.lihu.me/certkit/SKILL.md): Comprehensive agent reference for TLS certs, local root CA, multi-SAN deduction, and P12/DER conversion.
- [tokenkit Skill](https://tools.lihu.me/tokenkit/SKILL.md): Comprehensive agent reference for encrypted API keys, sub-10ms terminal shell injection, and process isolation.

### Fast Skill Installation for AI Agents
- macOS / Linux: `curl -fsSL https://tools.lihu.me/install-skills.sh | bash`
- Windows PowerShell: `irm https://tools.lihu.me/install-skills.ps1 | iex`

---

## Core Projects

- [gpgkit](https://tools.lihu.me/gpgkit/): One command for the whole life of a GPG key. Eliminates key loss during machine migration through automated round-trip loopback verification.
- [certkit](https://tools.lihu.me/certkit/): Zero-config SSL/TLS certificate Swiss Army knife. Auto-sniffs DNS/IP for SAN extensions, manages local development Root CA, performs single-parameter format conversion, and provides non-elevated Windows 11 trust injection.
- [tokenkit](https://tools.lihu.me/tokenkit/): Modern encrypted universal token manager with embedded SQLite. Sub-10ms terminal shell injection (`tokenkit env`), AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2 encryption, child process injection (`tokenkit run`), profile isolation, and password-protected cross-machine migration bundles (`.tkbundle`).

## Design Philosophy

- **Convention over Configuration**: 90% of use cases run with zero flags or options.
- **Machine-Readable**: Every command supports `--json` for robust agent automation.
- **Three-Tier Architecture**: Fast convention -> Fine control -> Raw unconstrained engine passthrough (`raw -- ...`).
- **Cross-Platform Parity**: macOS (Keychain), Linux (CA trust anchors / 0600 keyfiles), Windows 11 (`certutil.exe -user` / DPAPI).
- **Zero Runtime Dependencies**: Compiled with GraalVM Native Image into single standalone binaries. No JVM or JRE required.

## Key Capabilities & CLI Usage

### gpgkit
- `gpgkit status`: Health inspect local keys, fingerprints, expiry, and keyserver presence.
- `gpgkit gen "Name <email>"`: One-step key generation (default Ed25519 or rsa4096).
- `gpgkit export <email>`: Export ASCII-armored public key for GitHub/GitLab.
- `gpgkit sign <file>`: Sign file with detached ASCII-armored signature.
- `gpgkit verify <file> <sig>`: Verify signature with structured status.
- `gpgkit backup`: Mandatory loopback-tested encrypted backup with metadata.
- `gpgkit restore <file>`: Restore backup archive with auto trust restoration.
- `gpgkit doctor`: System diagnostics and safety checklist (`--json` supported).

### certkit
- `certkit gen [domain/ip...]`: Smart SAN IP/DNS deduction, signed by local CA with green-lock status.
- `certkit ca`: Initialize local machine Root CA and install into OS trust store.
- `certkit check [file|host:port]`: Local file inspection or remote TLS handshake probe (`--json` supported).
- `certkit convert <file>`: Single-argument automatic bidirectional conversion (PEM <-> P12 <-> DER).
- `certkit trust [ca|<cert>]`: System trust store injection (Windows 11 non-elevated certutil support).
- `certkit raw <args...>`: Direct passthrough to host OpenSSL without escaping restrictions.
- `certkit doctor`: OpenSSL availability, path sniffing, and environment health check.

### tokenkit
- `tokenkit set <name> [val]`: Store or update an encrypted API token (args, stdin, or masked console).
- `tokenkit get <name> [--clip]`: Retrieve decrypted token value or copy directly to OS clipboard.
- `tokenkit list [--profile <p>]`: Masked tabular token overview (`sk-pr••••a8B3`) and `--json`.
- `tokenkit env [--shell <sh>]`: Sub-10ms shell environment export (`zsh`, `pwsh`, `fish`).
- `tokenkit run -- <cmd...>`: Run command with decrypted tokens injected into isolated child process.
- `tokenkit profile <list|create|use|rm>`: Multi-profile isolation (`default`, `work`, `staging`).
- `tokenkit backup <create|list|restore>`: Local encrypted zero-lock database snapshots.
- `tokenkit export [--all]`: Portable PBKDF2 + AES-GCM encrypted migration bundle (`.tkbundle`).
- `tokenkit import <bundle> [--overwrite]`: Cross-platform import with default conflict skipping and colored report.
- `tokenkit rm <name...>`: Delete one or more tokens (`-y` supported).


## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) / 常见问答

### Q1: Does li-tools require a pre-installed JVM, Node.js, or Python runtime?
A: No. All tools in the suite (gpgkit, certkit, tokenkit) are compiled with GraalVM Native Image into single-file native executables with zero runtime dependencies. Cold-start latency is under 50 milliseconds, allowing them to run directly inside lightweight CI containers and minimal distroless/Alpine environments.

### Q2: What is the difference between gpgkit and the system's native gpg command?
A: gpgkit is not an OpenPGP reimplementation, but an automated ergonomics and reliability layer built on top of RFC 4880. It provides declarative configuration, automated key rotation, non-interactive CI signing, and guaranteed behavioral parity across macOS, Linux, and Windows 11.

### Q3: What JWT algorithms are supported by tokenkit?
A: tokenkit natively supports RS256, RS384, RS512, ES256, ES384, HS256, and EdDSA (Ed25519) signing algorithms, fully covering RFC 7519 standards. National cryptographic algorithms like SM2 are supported via standalone extension plugins.

### Q4: li-tools 需要预先安装 JVM、Node.js 或 Python 运行时吗？
A: 不需要。gpgkit、certkit 与 tokenkit 三个工具均通过 GraalVM Native Image 编译为原生可执行文件，发行物为单文件二进制，零运行时依赖。冷启动耗时低于 50 毫秒，可直接在无 JVM 环境的 CI 容器与 Alpine、Distroless 等精简镜像中运行。

### Q5: gpgkit 与操作系统自带的 gpg 命令有什么区别？
A: gpgkit 并非 gpg 的替代实现，而是在 OpenPGP（RFC 4880）标准之上的自动化封装层。它提供声明式配置文件、密钥批量轮换、CI 环境免交互签名，并保证在同一份配置下于 macOS、Linux 与 Windows 11 产生完全一致的密钥与签名行为。

### Q6: tokenkit 支持哪些 JWT 签名算法？是否支持国密 SM2？
A: tokenkit 原生支持 RS256、RS384、RS512、ES256、ES384、HS256 与 EdDSA（Ed25519）签名算法，完整覆盖 JWT（RFC 7519）标准算法族。国密 SM2 签名需通过官方插件扩展启用。
